Speech.NativeText: Okay here we go.. Hello? Hello...? Is anyone... yes! I can hear someone!
Is this FEMA? I'm.. uh.. requesting extraction. Can you get %1 out of here?
No, I don't have a pass. But, uh, %1 could trade with you or help you out... we could work together.
I'd need a new number to try.
You'll send someone over? Yeah I'll look out for them! You won't regret this!
That's it, I got through to someone! They're going to send a team to liase with %1!
That's it, I got through to someone this time! They're going to send a team to liase with %1!
Well, someone replied at least. They're sending a team. Let's hope they're who they say they are.
}:-| Keep your hands where I can see them, civilian! No sudden movements.
I'm the one who contacted you.
%1 already contacted them.
Talk to %1, outsider - I'm just here for backup. I sure hope you were worth this trip.
Hello, I'm the one who contacted you.
}:-| Where did you get our number from? Who knows about us?
It just got passed around, I don't know where it originated.
}:-| Yeah it's what I thought, you don't know shit. This mission was a waste of time.
}:-| Look, outsider, I'm real sorry but we're not giving green passes to any more refugees right now. Or ever. There's no spaces in the camp. Good luck with whatever you got going on over here.
Wait, so how can I get a green pass?

I told you we're not giving them out free anymore. But, sometimes we do still give 'em out to people who help us take down a major threat. There are some large organised groups of marauders around this countryside, some of them former army. And there's... other things, out there.
Our intel could direct them to your location on the promise of a large cache of loot. You take 'em all out, and you got yourself one green pass. I mean all of them, mind, not just one raiding party.

Oh yeah, and one green pass gets ONE person in the QZ. You want your family or your buddies to get in, you'll need one each. Frankly I don't fancy your chances, but it's your choice - you wanna risk it all and do this?
I'm the CO of a detachment east of Denver that got overrun. Your details were in our files. I demand asylum!

8-) Oh shit a Commanding Officer, I should be saluting... what did you say your unit was? }:-) Ah, I'm just messin' with you, don't try to bullshit me anymore though. }:-| And if you're really a CO, start by telling me the pass-phrase like the protocol says.
I found it scrawled on the wall of a restroom around here saying I should call it 'if I wanted a good time'.
}:-| Cute. We got ourselves a smartass here.
{:-| Well I never wanted to live with you anyway!
}:-| Riiiiight.
Yeah, hit me.
Not right now, I need to build up some defenses.
You got it, chief. Give us a call when you're ready for some serious shit to hit the fan.
Hello? Yes we've spoken before. Request to set up another meeting with FEMA operatives in this area.
You got it, chief. Get ready for the shit to hit the fan.
I'm told you'll do some work for us in exchange for a green pass.
And by 'work' I mean, 'kill a bunch of people'. And by 'people' I mean 'assholes'. Are you ready?
We've got a mission in mind for you. It's a real doozy of a mission. Are you ready?
:-) Nice, nice, great to meet you. And I heard you're looking for a green card to get into the Quarantine Zone? I can get you one of those.
The only thing I need from you is a bit of gold, to cover our expenses. Four hundred should do it. Do we have ourselves a deal?
Is this a joke?
I can't afford that right now.
Here's your gold.
Does your CO know you're taking bribes from refugees?
}:-) Great doing business with you! Now just... uh, sit tight and we'll be back real soon with your green passes. So long! Suckers.

I'm sure you can find it somewhere, you just gotta... dig deep. Think of how great it'll be having running water, electricity, movies, more food than you can eat... Come back to me when you got that gold! Don't take too long now.
}:-| No, it's not a joke. Don't insult me. I thought you were worth taking a chance on, we came all the way out here to meet you, but I guess I was wrong.
}:-[ My CO is dead, and so will you be, %1!
I'm not interested.

}:-( Hey, that's perfectly okay. We wasted our time, flew all the way out here for you, now you decide you don't want to part with your hard earned gold. Fair enough! I hope that decision works out for you!
I got the gold.
I changed my mind, I'm not interested.
:-) Yo! It's your lucky day, we've come to.. uh.. rescue you!
:-) Thank goodness you're here!
Actually it's fine, I don't need rescuing.
So, you got a big group here or what? Anything I should know about? Lots of... supplies? Gold?
:-) Yeah we're doing pretty well!
}:-| We're well defended.
It's just what you see right here.

I see. That's great. Okay, the way this works is you're going to need to give us a fee for rescuing you. It's 300 gold. Once we've got the fee we'll get you out of here, you'll be living in luxury, we got hot showers, electricity, meat, all that good shit.
I can't afford that right now.
Here's your gold.
}:-| I don't need to be rescued!
}:-[ It's not negotiable. You got 2 days to pay up. Otherwise, believe me, you will need to be rescued. And there ain't no one coming to do that.
You got 2 days to pay up.
}:-| Where'd you get all this? Got a lot more where that came from? }:-) Uh.. anyway, wait here and we'll come back to rescue you... soon, I promise! Real soon.
I got the gold.
Fuck off and don't come back here.
I'm not going to pay you, so fuck off and don't come back.
}:-[ And I thought you and I were going to be such great buddies! Ah well.
Are there more of you out here? How many?
It's just what you see right here.
}:-| We got a whole big army back here. Lots of guns.
It's a fair-sized settlement.
}:-| Why do you want to know that?
Easy now, it's just a formality. We just need know how many mouths you're gonna feed.
Don't you mean.. how many mouths we've got to feed?
Sure, that's what I said. Are you going to answer my fucking question?
}:-| Oh really.. not hiding anyone are you? Any... children with you?
How many women, and children?
I think it's time you left.
It's just a typical group of refugees. No children.
{:-( They never want to play with me.
:-) Cool, you've been really helpful! We'll be sending a team out to get you soon! Have a lovely day!
Looks like we owe you a green pass from the last job you did for us. Here it is. Congratulations, yada yada yada! You want more of them, you need to do some more work.
I want to use my Green Pass now. Get me out of here!
I want to use my Green Pass now. And I've given out %1 Green Passes to people in my group, besides myself. It's time for us to go.
}:-| You and %1 more mouths to feed, great. :-| Are you sure you're not leaving anyone behind?
No one that I really care about.
Actually there are people I don't want to leave.
How about that mission then?
Then I'll radio in a transport chopper for you. Welcome to FEMA, outsider!
Where is your green pass then?
I'll go and get it.
How can I use a Green Pass to get out of here?
I need to hear it from the leader of your group... and that ain't you.
It's just you, by yourself? You're not leaving anyone behind?
}:-| Sure you do, talk to %1, %2's in charge here.
:-) We're here to help! Talk to %1, %2's in charge here.
I'm the one who contacted you.
The hostiles have been eliminated. You owe me a green pass.
You're sending a crew? Understood, I'll be there.

Quest.NativeDescription: Try to seek refuge in one of the FEMA Quarantine Zones.
You need to be issued green passes by FEMA in order to be allowed to settle in a QZ. Try to get hold of some green passes for yourself and whoever you want to take with you.
Bring 400 gold to the FEMA team, before they leave (2 days).
Bring 300 gold to the looters, before they leave (2 days).
Defeat the raiders that FEMA intel are directing your way.
Give out green passes as gifts to whoever in your community you want to take with you. But keep one for yourself, of course.
